identity: Create ONE master still of a new original game NPC: a THIN ELDERLY MALE escaped-prisoner KEEPER. Full body, RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, slightly hunched from carrying baggage but standing at ease, both boots firmly on floor. Large pointed nose, short gray beard and gray side hair, calm tired tan face, clearly readable LARGE DARK EYE at least 3% of body height, prominent eyebrow. A worn long HOODED charcoal-brown coat with muted teal inner lining and broad patched cuffs, the raised hood surrounds his face without hiding the eye. A HUGE rectangular battered WOODEN STORAGE CHEST is securely strapped to his BACK behind him to the left: solid wooden cuboid with broad gray steel reinforcing bands and a BIG visibly closed steel PADLOCK on its outer side. The box is a trunk, not a backpack or bag. Its top is BELOW the top of his hood so his hood defines the character's height. Coarse leather straps wrap over the shoulders and across his chest. Near arm reaches forward with a hanging simple warm AMBER LANTERN at waist/knee height, one hand holds the large loop handle. Far hand lightly grips a chest strap. A small muted cyan crystal charm hangs at the chest buckle. Both forearms and both boots readable. His narrow curved body and oversized squared back load make an unmistakable carrier silhouette. Leave all the chest and lantern inside canvas with clear margins. Use reference ONLY for flat angular art treatment, eye readability, discrete shading and ground scale. This is an elderly man with different face, hair, coat and build. Flat lineless broad planes, three hard shades per material, tan skin two flat tones, upper-left light, restrained palette, tiny cyan edge highlight on clothing or metal only, no skin rim light. Broad clear clusters for a finished 117px sprite. No gradients, glow spill, texture noise, outline, weapon, letters, numbers, logo, emblem, ground line, cast shadow, other character or effects. Flat PURE #FF00FF background. Centered full character on 1024x1024 square with generous 10% margins.
